Recorded claim:
BCT7: retain tab-close `tabindex=-1`; bracket only the synthetic pointer click with `AccessibilityUtils.setEnv({ focusableRule: false })`/`resetEnv()`. Close and await hiding of non-modal Calendar dialogs inside each positioning loop. Chat controls need a real named button, `aria-expanded`, stopped Space/Enter propagation, and native padding/border reset; chat-log tree name uses `aria-labelledby="logTreeLabel"`. [Task 1]
